name: Agent Sandbox Isolation
description: Two-layer isolation model for agent workloads: an OS sandbox around the agent process itself, and a stronger execution boundary around the entire environment, designed to contain blast radius from prompt injection or compromised agents.

edges.quote: Isolate the agent. The entire agent runs in a sandbox with zero secrets. It talks to the outside world through a control plane that holds all the credentials
Always assume inputs can be adversarial.
A common answer is to give the sandbox only a short-lived session token and route privileged operations through a proxy or control plane
Agents introduce a new set of deployment needs and constraints
